Three.js 0.169.0: MIT, upstream license in vendor/THREE-LICENSE.txt. Downloaded from https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.169.0.tgz .

Poly Haven textures: CC0 1.0; https://polyhaven.com/license . Asset-specific original download URLs and pages in textures/metadata.json. Individual contributor metadata could not be retrieved (API 403); no author names are invented. Resized and converted to WebP.

Only albedo maps use sRGB. GL normal and roughness maps are data textures (NoColorSpace), not sRGB. These generic material textures are not documentation of the actual Tianli Central Plaza building.
